title: Tensor nuclear norm minimization with linear constraints
summary: We study the tensor nuclear norm minimization with general linear constraints, a fundamental model for low-rank tensor optimization that includes many practical applications in computer vision, recommendation systems, revenue management, transportation research. Although the tensor nuclear norm is a convex surrogate for the tensor rank, optimizing it remains computationally challenging because evaluating the nuclear norm itself is NP-hard.
